name: Tooth
source:
The main character(Who you play as) is a 18 year-old serving is last year of high school. Mc is a bullied kid with a dark past.  He then finds a tooth with a demon attached to it. You're now working with the demon to make your life better while also befriending him. Along the way you make friends with your peers, and even more. It's a nice romantic story that teaches you life lessons.

[From [url=https://blu3be4ry.itch.io/tooth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角（你扮演的角色）是一名18岁的高中生，正在读高中最后一年。麦克是一个被欺负的孩子，有着黑暗的过去。然后他发现了一颗附有恶魔的牙齿。你现在正在与恶魔合作，让你的生活变得更好，同时也与他成为朋友。一路上你会与同龄人交朋友，甚至更多。这是一个美好的浪漫故事，可以教会你人生课程。

[来自[url=https://blu3be4ry.itch.io/tooth]Itch.io[/url]]
